title: Drones Over Brooklyn
subtitle: This was not on my dance card for 2024.
body_html:
So, I'm at home, eating some Trader Joe's, like you do in North Williamsburg, Brooklyn, and suddenly we have these interlopers. If you've been reading about drones, and wondering what they look like, this is what they look like when they're hanging out over the east river, here in New York.

And that's just a photograph, if only there was a video. OK, here are some videos.

I asked my son what was going on, and he says, well, it's some sort of shenanigans.

In this context, I think my son is correct. We're not sure who the shenanigans belong to, or what the intention of the shenanigans are, but these are absolutely shenanigans in the sky, and that's somewhat unsettling.

Look forward to figuring out what the shenanigans are, as I'm sure do we all. But the shenanigans have begun.

My son is asking what's going to happen. I think a lot of people are asking what's going to happen. And none of us know, that's the actual answer.

Radical acceptance is the only option I have, I mean I could run away, we all could, but to where, and to do what?

I can tell you that I've been thinking a lot about how I spend my time, and if it makes sense, if it were all to end tomorrow?

I don't know that I'd spend as much time on maintenance of certification, and I might spend more time telling you all:

I love you.

Reporting from Brooklyn…The Frontier Psychiatrists.
